baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ownership clause spans the heavens and earth, then closes with capacity over every thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sovereign authority, upper and lower spatial bounds, exhaustive totality, and effective capacity combine into exclusive jurisdiction; punishment and forgiveness are two exercises of one governance rather than rival impulses.

activation_trace.role: Supplies sovereign rule and policy as the governing center of the model.
Supplies the upper, overshadowing extent of the governed domain.
Supplies the lower counterpart, completing the vertical span.
Turns the closing claim into comprehensive inclusion without an outside remainder.
Makes the jurisdiction effectual through capacity to act and govern.

changed_reading.before: A general assertion that God can punish some people and forgive others.
changed_reading.after: The pair is an exercise of exclusive jurisdiction spanning the whole upper-lower domain, with no competing power outside it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated willing is followed by qadir, whose inventory includes measure, limit, and deliberate ordering.
baseline_models.mechanism: Capacity includes setting a thing's measure and arranging it with deliberation; divine disposition can therefore be read as exact ordering of punishment and forgiveness, not merely unlimited force.

activation_trace.role: Links each act of willing to an object brought within intentional disposition.
Supplies bounded amount, term, and proportion as the precision of the disposition.
Supplies deliberative preparation and ordering rather than raw exertion.
Frames measured capacity as what upholds and organizes the entire affair.

changed_reading.before: Qadir means only that no act is too difficult.
changed_reading.after: Qadir also activates calibrated rule: each punitive or forgiving disposition can have a set measure, timing, and fit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two coordinated verbs are yu'adhdhibu and yaghfiru under one repeated willing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The punishment root carries both painful penalty and withholding or weaning, while forgiveness carries protective covering; the pair can operate as opposite boundary actions, restraining exposure on one side and shielding from its effects on the other.

activation_trace.role: Keeps explicit painful penalty as the primary punitive pole.
Adds withholding and enforced separation as a boundary-making mode of punishment.
Supplies a covering that protects what it encloses.
Specifies that covering as protection of the culpable person from the deed's punitive effect.
Places both boundary operations under intentional willing.

changed_reading.before: Punishment harms whereas forgiveness simply erases.
changed_reading.after: The pair can be seen as sovereign control of exposure: imposing restraint or penalty, and placing a culpable person under protective covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pair becomes procedurally contoured: repentance precedes human capture-capacity, punishment deters, and repentance joined to repair is followed by protective forgiveness.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the punitive side in actual penalty rather than an abstract contrast.
Anchors the merciful side in shielding the person from punitive consequence.
Makes temporal priority functional: the repentance comes before the power threshold.
Supplies the human ability to seize as a procedural boundary under divine capacity.
Gives punishment a forward-looking deterrent function beyond pain to its recipient.
Makes repair of what was disordered part of the route toward mercy.
Confirms protective forgiveness immediately after repentance and repair.

structural_cues: The exception in 5:34 is explicitly before human power is acquired.
The theft penalty in 5:38 is immediately followed in 5:39 by repentance, repair, and divine forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies timing, deterrence, repair, and forgiveness; I infer that these are local operating contours of 5:40's pair. A live alternative is that they are separate legal conditions rather than a general account of divine willing.

changed_reading.before: Whom God punishes or forgives can sound detached from process.
changed_reading.after: In this legal sequence the pair has visible gates: capacity and timing matter, punishment can deter, and repaired conduct opens protective mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine ownership governs which conversions of liability are valid: guilt returns and is loaded onto its bearer, total earthly wealth fails as a substitute, but relinquishing a rightful claim can become expiatory covering.

activation_trace.role: Anchors authority over the disposition of liability in sovereign rule.
Supplies the enforceable consequence whose commutation is at issue.
Supplies valid protection from a deed's punitive effect.
Makes wrongdoing return upon and settle with its bearer.
Supplies the loading and reckoning of culpable burden.
Supplies the attempted substitution of property for the exposed person.
Marks that even the total ransom is not received as a valid conversion.
Turns voluntary relinquishment of a due claim into a truthful gift.
Supplies expiation as an authorized covering and removal of sin.

structural_cues: 5:29 imagines a killer bearing two sins.
5:36 denies acceptance even to the whole earth plus its equal as ransom.
5:45 permits waived retaliation to become expiation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attached guilt, failed material substitution, and successful expiatory relinquishment; I infer a sovereignty-controlled economy of moral liability. The alternative is to keep the three episodes legally separate without a shared conversion rule.

changed_reading.before: Punishment and forgiveness are interchangeable outcomes of unconstrained choice.
changed_reading.after: Sovereignty determines non-fungible moral transformations: wealth cannot purchase release, while a rightful act of relinquishment can become covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated will, possession, and thing language of 5:41 places the focus pair beside assay and purification, shifting sovereign judgment from only external outcomes toward processes that expose or cleanse moral condition.

activation_trace.role: Anchors both outcomes in intentional disposition toward an object.
Provides the protective-covering pole that purification can sharpen without replacing.
Supplies an assay in which hidden quality is exposed under testing.
States that an intermediary possesses no disposable counter-resource against God.
Makes the negated counter-resource maximally general: not even one identifiable thing.
Supplies cleansing as removal of contaminating condition.
Moves cleansing into the ethical interior of self and action.

structural_cues: 5:41 repeats divine willing twice, denies possessing anything against God, and opposes fitna to a will to purify hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, non-possession, and purification; I infer a process parallel to punishment and forgiveness. A live alternative is that fitna and purification name distinct outcomes nearby rather than mechanisms internal to the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: Punishment and forgiveness are verdicts applied after a condition is already known.
changed_reading.after: Sovereign willing may also expose condition through assay or remove its contamination through cleansing, without any counter-possession overriding the process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exclusive divine dominion does not eliminate human agency; it creates accountable delegation in which entrusted people preserve, witness, oversee, and judge without acquiring the source ownership.

activation_trace.role: Anchors ultimate policy and authority in divine sovereignty.
Adds the sustaining principle on which delegated offices depend.
Defines entrustment as active guarding rather than possession for private use.
Requires custodians to be present and answerable witnesses.
Adds oversight and attestation across the entrusted textual field.
Supplies delegated adjudication as an assigned exercise of authority.

structural_cues: 5:44 says custodians were entrusted with God's book and were witnesses over it.
5:48 describes the later book as overseeing and commands judgment by what God sent down.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entrustment, witness, oversight, and commanded judgment; I infer a governance chain under the ownership claim of 5:40. The alternative is a narrower account of textual custody with no general implication for dominion.

changed_reading.before: Because dominion belongs only to God, meaningful human governance appears excluded.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive ownership can authorize real but answerable custodial judgment: authority is delegated while source ownership remains divine.

context_deltas.mechanism: The will that could make one community instead allocates a path to each, tests people within what they receive, and redirects rivalry toward goods; nonuniformity becomes a purposive use of capacity rather than a limit upon it.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the focus's repeated intentional willing.
Keeps unity genuinely possible, so plurality is not explained by incapacity.
Distributes an assignment comprehensively to each community.
Supplies entry into a distinct normative course.
Makes the assigned course visible and traversable rather than arbitrary obscurity.
Directly repeats willing in the counterfactual of making one community.
Makes differentiated conditions an examination that reveals response.
Confirms the same revealing-test image through the second resolved root target.
Converts difference into forward competition rather than forced sameness.
Fixes beneficial good, not difference itself, as the direction of competition.

structural_cues: 5:48 states a law and clear way for each, says God could have made one community, gives testing as the counter-purpose, and commands racing in good things.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies possible unity, maintained difference, testing, and competition in good; I infer that this gives 5:40's will a purposive nonuniform mode. The alternative is historical accommodation rather than a positive mechanism of differentiated testing.

changed_reading.before: Whom God wills may sound like unexplained selection of isolated individuals.
changed_reading.after: The same will can intentionally maintain differentiated paths, reveal conduct within each assignment, and orient judgment toward the race in good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit willing to make some sins strike their owners combines target-arrival, a measured part, and the sin root's tail and allotted-share images; punishment becomes the controlled arrival of part of an act's own aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the proposed aftermath in the focus's punitive verb.
Supplies the measure that limits the consequence to an apportioned part.
Directly renews the focus's command to know before explaining the punitive will.
Makes the consequence reach and settle on its intended target.
Adds the non-dominant image of an exhausting burden to the experienced consequence.
Restricts the impact to a divided portion rather than an undifferentiated total.
Activates the deed's trailing end as an image for consequence following action.
Adds an allotted share, matching the text's explicit partiality.

structural_cues: 5:49 repeats know and divine will, then makes some of their own sins the means by which they are struck.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affliction by some sins plus target, portion, tail, and share images; I supply the arrow from an act to its returning aftermath. The alternative is an externally imposed penalty for sins with no tail-like causal rendering.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an unrelated force imposed after wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as the measured arrival of part of wrongdoing's own trailing consequence, with divine capacity governing its target and share.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fear-driven actors treat dominion as a circulating worldly turn and rush toward protective affiliation; the focus's total ownership reframes feared defeat, opening, and command as changing conditions inside one encompassing sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the counter-model in sovereignty that exceeds temporary political possession.
Keeps every feared turn within effective divine capacity.
Supplies dimmed inner clarity as the condition producing the faulty power calculus.
Turns fear into premature movement before the political outcome is known.
Supplies circulating states and exchanged political conditions.
Specifies the feared turn as defeat or adverse reversal.
Makes the awaited opening also a decisive judicial resolution.
Adds disclosure that opens what fear and secrecy had closed.
Locates the decisive alternative in authority rather than the feared alliance.

structural_cues: In 5:52 inner disease leads to hurried affiliation from fear of a turn; an opening or command then exposes what was hidden and produces regret.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear, haste, circulating defeat, opening, and authority; I infer that 5:40 contests this model of political ownership. The alternative is a local warning about hypocrisy without a general contrast between cyclical power and dominion.

changed_reading.before: Ownership of heavens and earth is a static cosmological claim.
changed_reading.after: It also corrects panic before worldly power cycles: adverse turns and victories circulate, but none becomes a rival sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: After threatened defection, divine will does more than punish or pardon: it can bring a replacement people, establish reciprocal love, distribute surplus gift, and act from expansive capacity joined to knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the new mode in the same repeated willing as punishment and forgiveness.
Supplies capacity to reconstitute agency rather than merely terminate it.
Supplies defection as the failure that occasions replacement.
Adds the split-root image of becoming stripped of good, intensifying the failed condition.
Makes the replacement relation reciprocal and heart-binding rather than merely instrumental.
Supplies an excess beyond equivalence, opening a third mode beyond penalty and remission.
Identifies that excess as beneficent gift.
Directly repeats divine willing as the distributor of the gift.
Makes divine scope expansive rather than confined to the focus's two named outcomes.
Joins expansive gift to disclosed knowledge rather than blind abundance.

structural_cues: 5:54 answers possible defection by saying God will bring another people, describes reciprocal love, then calls the result God's bounty given to whom He wills and closes with expansive knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies replacement, reciprocal love, bounty, repeated willing, expansiveness, and knowledge; I infer a generative third mode alongside punishment and forgiveness. The alternative is that bounty is a separate communal promise with no revision of the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: Sovereign will in 5:40 offers only the binary of penalty or pardon.
changed_reading.after: The later repetition adds generative grace: will can replace failed agents, create a loving community, and give surplus good.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because burial concealment is not itself divine forgiveness. It remains anchored because the focus joins God's earth to gh-f-r covering, while 5:31 makes the earth the medium that teaches covering of an exposed human ruin. Render it only as a material analogy for protective forgiveness, never as an equation of burial with absolution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places the earth inside divine dominion and uses a forgiveness root whose primary material image is protective covering.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the material medium inside the explicitly owned lower domain.
Supplies covering whose function is to protect what it encloses.
The earth is first disturbed and opened in order to disclose a practical response.
Makes the same lower domain an active pedagogical material rather than inert territory.
Supplies the repeated act of placing the exposed thing behind a cover.
Identifies what requires covering as an exposed shame or vulnerable part.

changed_reading.before: Earth is merely one half of the spatial inventory, and forgiveness is an abstract cancellation.
changed_reading.after: The owned earth can activate a concrete pedagogy of covering exposed ruin, materially imaging the protective side of forgiveness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's resolved w-s-m target under the sky root; it must not be offered as a lexical translation of samawat. It remains worth carrying because the focus opens with knowing, the knowledge inventory includes guiding marks, and the context supplies visible signs and witnessing. Render it as a branch-triggered suggestion that the heavens function as displayed evidence of dominion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rhetorical demand to know is immediately supported by the heavens, whose split inventory includes a visible identifying mark.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a distinguishing mark that guides recognition.
Keeps the actual heavenly expanse as the model's visible focus object.
Activates the non-dominant image of an identifying trace visible to an observer.
Adds the context's explicit image of a manifest sign.
Lets a sign function as testimony rather than decoration.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only territory listed as divine property.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the heavens also function as the displayed mark by which the opening question expects dominion to be recognized.

strongest_changes: The punitive-forgiving pair acquired procedural gates: pre-capture timing, deterrence, repentance, and repair.
Divine ownership became authority over non-fungible moral liability, where wealth fails as ransom but relinquished right can become expiation.
The repeated will in 5:48 became purposeful nonuniformity: differentiated paths expose conduct and redirect competition toward good.
The repeated will in 5:54 added generative grace, replacement, reciprocal love, and surplus gift beyond the initial penalty-pardon binary.
summary.what_was_special: Exact focus roots recur as mechanisms across the packet: q-d-r marks a human capture threshold, m-l-k and sh-y-' deny counter-possession during assay, sh-y-' explains both maintained plurality and bounty, and 'ilm reopens the focus question before consequence. Material and split-root images also exposed two readings likely to be lost in synthesis: earth as a pedagogy of covering and sin as a measured trailing share.
remaining_uncertainties: The liability-conversion model may unify episodes that retain distinct legal functions.
Assay and purification may only neighbor punishment and forgiveness rather than describe their internal processes.
The consequence-tail, earth-covering, and sky-mark readings require explicit analogical or exploratory qualification.
